newsitem.title: USA: FoxMeyer Health sues McKesson Corp - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: FoxMeyer Health sues McKesson Corp - WSJ.

text.p: FoxMeyer Health Corp on Friday filed a lawsuit accusing drug distributor McKesson Corp and a dozen pharmaceutical manufacturers of conspiring to wreck its drug wholesaling business, The Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
In the suit, filed in Dallas, Texas, FoxMeyer is asking for more than $400 million in compensatory damages and unspecified punitive damages, the story said.
The suit says McKesson and the manufacturers feared that FoxMeyer's new drug distribution system would revolutionize the industry, undercuting the competition's profits, the Journal said.
FoxMeyer alleges that McKesson plotted to acquire FoxMeyer Drug, the company's former primary operating unit, at a "fire-sale price" while strengtheneing its own ties with the manufacturers.
FoxMeyer Drug filed for protection under Chapter 11 in August, the story said.
A McKesson spokeswoman told the Journal she had not heard of the suit.
